name: TMC2209 Stepper Motor Driver
description: The `tmc2209` stepper platform supports the Trinamic TMC2209 stepper motor driver ([datasheet](https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/TMC2209_datasheet_rev1.09.pdf)). The driver is configured over its single wire UART interface. Several drivers can share one UART bus by using different addresses.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The UART address of the driver, `0` to `3`. Defaults to `0`.

config_entries.label: UART ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [UART bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart/) the driver is connected to. Required if you have multiple UART buses.

config_entries.label: Diag Pin
config_entries.description: The `DIAG` pin of the driver. Must be a pin that supports interrupts. The driver sets this pin high on a driver error or a stall. See [Driver Status](https://esphome.io/components/stepper/tmc2209/#driver-status) and [Stall Detection](https://esphome.io/components/stepper/tmc2209/#stall-detection).

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Input
config_entries.description: Set the input mode flag.

config_entries.label: Output
config_entries.description: Set the output mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pullup
config_entries.description: Set the pullup mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pulldown
config_entries.description: Set the pulldown mode flag.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Dir Pin
config_entries.description:
**Set together — all of these must be set, or all left blank:** `step_pin`, `dir_pin`.

The `DIR` pin of the driver. Required when `step_pin` is set.

config_entries.label: Index Pin
config_entries.description:
**Required — set exactly one of:** `index_pin`, `step_pin`.

The `INDEX` pin of the driver. Enables UART speed control mode. Must be a pin that supports interrupts. Exactly one of `step_pin` or `index_pin` is required.

config_entries.label: Max Speed
config_entries.description: The maximum speed in `steps/s` (steps per seconds) to drive the stepper at. Note most steppers can't step properly with speeds higher than 250 steps/s.

config_entries.label: Step Pin
config_entries.description:
**Required — set exactly one of:** `index_pin`, `step_pin`.

**Set together — all of these must be set, or all left blank:** `step_pin`, `dir_pin`.

The `STEP` pin of the driver. Enables STEP/DIR mode. Exactly one of `step_pin` or `index_pin` is required.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Specify the ID of the stepper so that you can control it.

config_entries.label: Acceleration
config_entries.description: The acceleration in `steps/s^2` (steps per seconds squared) to use when starting to move. The default is `inf` which means infinite acceleration, so the stepper will try to drive with the full speed immediately. This value is helpful if that first motion of the motor is too jerky for what it's moving. If you make this a small number, it will take the motor a moment to get up to speed.

config_entries.label: Analog Current Scale
config_entries.description: Scale the motor current with the voltage on the `VREF` pin of the driver. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Clock Frequency
config_entries.description: The clock frequency of the driver. Only used to convert the speed in UART speed control mode. Change this when the driver runs from an external clock. Defaults to `12MHz`.

config_entries.label: Deceleration
config_entries.description: The same as `acceleration`, but for when the motor is decelerating shortly before reaching the set position. Defaults to `inf` (immediate deceleration).

config_entries.label: Hold Current
config_entries.description: The motor current at standstill, in A RMS.

config_entries.label: Microsteps
config_entries.description: The number of microsteps per full step. One of `1`, `2`, `4`, `8`, `16`, `32`, `64`, `128` or `256`. Written to the driver at startup, which then ignores the `MS1` and `MS2` pins. Default: `16`.

config_entries.label: Ottrim
config_entries.description: The overtemperature thresholds, `0` to `3`. See the `OTTRIM` setting in the datasheet. When not set, the driver setting is not changed.

config_entries.label: Rsense
config_entries.description: The value of the external sense resistors on the driver module, for example `110 mOhm`. Used to convert currents to driver settings. When not set, the driver is switched to its internal sense resistors, which only works on boards designed for it. Most driver modules have external sense resistors.

config_entries.label: Run Current
config_entries.description: The motor current while running, in A RMS. Values above the maximum of the driver are limited to the maximum and a warning is logged. The maximum is shown in the log at startup.

config_entries.label: Vsense
config_entries.description: Use the high sensitivity sense voltage range. This lowers the maximum current and gives finer current steps, useful for small motors. When not set, the driver setting is not changed.
